positions.as_written: Expect the group effect rather than individual prediction, and say so, because screening an individual does not perform as well as the group data suggests.
Address hip and trunk control alongside the knee, since the position being targeted is produced above the joint as well as at it.
Expect a relative risk reduction rather than elimination, and set that expectation with the athlete.
Avoid individual screening as a basis for selection or exclusion, since the tests do not perform at that level.
